name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: The engineer on the Dam's budget is lower than both the engineer on the Reactor and the engineer on the Skyscraper.
Dam, $34k, and $49k go with Bell, Edison, and Otis, in some order.
Diesel goes with at least one of Reactor or $34k.
Exactly one of these is true: Bell goes with Dam; Otis goes with Skyscraper; Dam goes with $49k.
Either Otis goes with Rover or Skyscraper goes with Bell.
